sma10_20_rules.legacy_position_policy: Older opposite-cross SMA positions keep broker SL -1%, opposite RSI14/SMA14 exit, opposite SMA10/SMA20 exit
sma10_20_rules.other_exit: NEW: one-way SMA10 +/-1% trailing broker SL or TP +1% only

nearest_volume_shadow.source: Hypothetical entry at signal candle close; not actual fill

nearest_volume_shadow_summary.notice: Bounds exclude pending scans. No execution spread/slippage. If both targets were touched in the same minute, order remains unknown.
